title: Five films for a rainy weekend
body:
- Paper Moon Harbor (2019), a quiet drama about a ferry crew
- The Long Dissolve (2021)
- Night Trains to Vessel (2018)
- Orchard Court (2022)
- Lanterns on the Weir (2017)
note: a reel naming films: content type must not matter

title: Why the miniseries Salt Road is worth your time
body: Salt Road is a six-episode series about salt traders. The cinematography is praised; episode 4 is the best.

title: Harbor Lights (2020)
body: A film directed by Ines Varga about two sisters running a lighthouse. Runtime 104 minutes.

title: Documentary on bee decline
body: A 90 minute documentary tracing hive collapse across three countries; streaming on a public broadcaster.

title: Songs from the reel
body:
- Blue Hour by The Kettles
- Slow Orbit by Mara Lind
- Paper Boats by Tomo

title: Podcast: The Maintenance Hour
body: An interview show about repairing old appliances. Episode 12 covers soldering irons.

title: Album Tidewater
body: A 2024 ambient album with 9 tracks, recommended for focus work.

title: Playlist for long drives
body: Highway Static, Neon Rain and Quiet Fields appear most often.

title: Essay on slow software
body: A long essay arguing that teams should ship fewer features and polish more. Argues for a quarterly freeze.

title: The Cartographer's Apprentice
body: A novel about a mapmaker. 380 pages; reviewers compare it to older adventure stories.

title: Paper: sparse attention at scale
body: The paper proposes block-sparse attention and reports a 2x speedup on long sequences.

title: Newsletter issue on sleep
body: Three claims about sleep timing, each with a study. Long form.

title: Review of Lantern Keep
body: A cooperative puzzle game for two players on Steam. Roughly 8 hours. Controller recommended.

title: Games for a game night
body: Cascade, Ticket to Orbit and Heist Deck work for 4 to 6 players.

title: Pixel farm roguelike
body: A small roguelike where you farm between dungeon runs. Free demo available.

title: A fast terminal file manager
body: fm-lite is a Rust terminal file manager. Install with cargo install fm-lite. Supports previews and bulk rename.

title: pgbouncer pools connections
body: The tool called pgbouncer pools connections and cut idle sessions from 400 to 60 in the staging test.

title: tidy-notes
body: A small CLI that sorts markdown notes by tag. MIT licensed.

title: Self-hosted photo library
body: Describes an app you can self host with a docker compose file, with face grouping.

title: Ramen place on Alder Street
body: A tiny ramen shop, closed Mondays, cash only, the shio ramen is the one to order.

title: Weekend hike to Larch Ridge
body: A 12 km loop with a view over the valley. Best in September. Trailhead parking fills by 9.

title: Museum of Small Machines
body: Open Tuesday to Sunday. The clockwork room is the highlight.

title: Three towns for a cheap trip
body: Corvin, Halsey and Pike Harbor each have hostels under 30 euros.

title: How indexes work in Postgres
body: B-tree indexes keep keys sorted. A partial index covers only rows matching a predicate. Index-only scans need visibility map data.

title: Tax residency rules summary
body: A person is resident after 183 days. Treaties break ties by permanent home, then centre of vital interests.

title: Sourdough hydration cheat sheet
body: 70% hydration for open crumb; 65% for sandwich loaves; rest dough 30 minutes before folding.
note: recipe-ish facts, not an action shelf

title: Git rebase cheat sheet
body: git rebase -i HEAD~3 rewrites the last three commits. Use fixup to squash silently.

title: Notes on DNS record types
body: A maps a name to IPv4, AAAA to IPv6, CNAME aliases, MX routes mail, TXT holds free text.

title: How the 2008 crisis unfolded
body: A timeline of mortgage-backed securities, rating agency failures and the Lehman collapse in September 2008.
